sources.title: Pololu 4752 gearmotor
sources.note: Selected baseline. 200 g each, 1920 quadrature counts/output revolution. Stall values are extrapolations.

sources.title: Pololu 4035 DRV8874 carrier
sources.note: Selected baseline. 2.1 A carrier continuous rating in open-air tests. Adjustable limit and default sleep. The product page listed backorders at the review.

sources.title: Waveshare ST3215 series
sources.note: Selected 12 V variant, powered from a regulated 9 V branch. 12 V advertised stall torque does not qualify 9 V hold duty.

sources.title: Waveshare ST3215 documentation
sources.note: The current page specifies 6–12.6 V for the 12 V version. Confirm the actual revision and protect against regenerative voltage rise.

sources.title: Raspberry Pi Pico 2
sources.note: RP2350, C/C++ SDK, PIO encoders, SPI IMU, USB logs. The board timing is still not measured.

sources.title: SparkFun LSM6DSO Qwiic SEN-18020
sources.note: Received with the Pico 2, per user confirmation on October 3. The individual price in the $30.58 combined order is unconfirmed. Main SPI/I2C, exposed interrupts, 3.3 V supply/logic. It replaces the earlier Adafruit LSM6DSOX selection. Qualify readback and timing.

sources.title: TI DRV8874 datasheet
sources.note: Use the datasheet tolerances for current regulation and IPROPI sampling. Do a bench test of the braking and current-chopping behavior.

wheel_driver.current_regulation: IMODE tied to ground: fixed off-time, fault does not report routine chopping; MCU latches real faults

leg_servo.part: Waveshare ST3215, 30 kg-cm at 12 V variant
leg_servo.state: selected; mounted duty at 9 V unqualified

controller.state: one Pico 2 with pre-soldered headers received 2026-10-03; inspection/USB and firmware qualification open

imu.state: one SparkFun LSM6DSO Qwiic IMU received per user 2026-10-03; identification and sensor qualification open

cameras.decision: External existing phone/camera for synchronized trial video; perception deferred to V2

manual_link.decision: Existing laptop/gamepad over USB serial deadman for fixture trials; qualified RC reuse for untethered trials

battery.decision: 3S 2.2 Ah lithium pack; exact reused pack and charger require inventory and condition check

power.decision: 9 V regulated servo branch, separate 5 V logic branch, fused wheel branch, hardware cut and regeneration clamp; part numbers after simultaneous-load bench sizing
